narr: There was significant flash flooding including a building collapse and a water rescue in Canandaigua in the late afternoon as some estimates point to a 100 year flood event. A state of emergency was declared for Ontario county. Flash flooding also occurred in portions of Lewis County into the early evening. Numerous roads in these counties were flooded and impassable with some washed out. A weak wave of low pressure stalled along a trough combined with increasing moisture and instability to focus waves of showers and thunderstorms with very heavy rain. The axis of heaviest rain stretched from Ontario County to Lewis County. Rainfall amounts along this axis were uneven, but there were pockets of extreme rainfall with over 5.5 inches near Canandaigua in Ontario county and over 4 inches between Lowville and Croghan in Lewis county.
